progress.py counts a subtask's settle rounds as the highest N among plan/review files matching {subtask_id}-*.outcomes.json whose names end -rN.outcomes.json (glob :141, regex :26), raised by any 'cycle N' or 'round N' in that subtask's review INDEX verdict note or advisories (:145-148); no round found gives None (:149).
The _rounds docstring says outcomes files win over the verdict-cell note (progress.py:137-138), but the code keeps the larger of the two (:139-148).

The emitted rounds value (progress.py:74) has three readers: _sub_phase (:78, :182; 'settle round N' at :189, 'after N round(s)' at :196), the progress renderer (shell.html:946, inside if (s.review) at :941), and test_contract.py:519. sub_phase goes on to shell.html:350, :903, :925 and test_contract.py:520, :522. Overview reads only the status counts and the row count (overview.py:47-48).

No feature outcomes file can match the glob at progress.py:141 for a tracker id: the glob matches only names beginning '{subtask_id}-', tracker ids are NNNN-slug (to-subtasks/PLAN-TEMPLATE.md:38-42), and the feature writer's names begin 'feature-' (preflight/SKILL.md:119). With feature-def456-r3.outcomes.json beside the A10 fixture, both subtask globs skip it and the counts stay 2 and None.
_ROUND_FILE_RE already parses the feature form: on feature-def456-r3.outcomes.json it yields 3, and a glob of feature-*.outcomes.json over the same review dir returns only the feature file.

A round number taken from outcomes file names counts only rounds that wrote a file: step 3 ends the loop on a round with no actionable finding (review/SETTLEMENT.md:15) before step 7 writes that round's -r{n} file (:19). A PF-3 loop that settles would show one fewer than the rounds it ran, and one clean in round 1 would show nothing, while the PF-3 Cycle cell (preflight/SKILL.md:107), already shown in Gates, is the referee's own count; the two numbers can differ.

Whether a resumed PF-3 (preflight/SKILL.md:45-47) restarts round numbers at r1 or continues them is not stated in preflight or SETTLEMENT.md; if it restarts, the highest r{n} across feature files mixes two loops.

Keep the feature count out of data['subtasks']: overview.py:47-48 count that list's statuses and rows (shown at shell.html:523-544), and shell.html:342, :900-905 and :1141-1145 treat every row as a plan subtask. A new top-level key beside subtasks, counts and ladder (progress.py:85) is ignored by every current reader. A1 asserts two rows (test_contract.py:303) but its fixture has no feature file, so the current suite would not catch a pseudo-row.

Showing the count needs a shell.html edit: RENDER['progress'] reads only d.ladder and d.subtasks (shell.html:892-966), so a new key renders nowhere by itself; skills/afk/CLAUDE.md:3 names the shell as a live section's renderer half. No test runs the page script: the A-suite asserts on the embedded JSON (test_contract.py:1-2), so the display is unguarded.

Only test_contract.py references mission_control or mc among files whose path holds 'test', and nothing in this repository runs it automatically: the one workflow runs hooks/release-gate.sh (.github/workflows/release-gate.yml:36-37) and the runner search found only a wiring-gate comment (hooks/wiring-gate.sh:57).
